title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x1
episodes_data.description: A mysterious Eevee runs away from the Eevee Evolution Laboratory and meets Chloe. Meanwhile, Team Rocket makes a plan to steal some students' Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x2
episodes_data.description: Ash, Goh and Chloe head to the Galar region to investigate some of its unusual fossils. The on-site researchers want to reconstruct the ancient Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x3
episodes_data.description: Investigating an outbreak of Geodude in Rock Tunnel, Ash and Goh meet a trainer who accepts Ash's challenge to a World Coronation battle with Gurdurr!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x4
episodes_data.description: When Professor Cerise's former student asks for help with some Diglett and Dugtrio wreaking havoc on his farm, Goh, Ash and Chloe go check it out.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x5
episodes_data.description: Hearing rumors that the legendary Suicune has been spotted at a lake, Ash and Goh travel to the Johto region, where they find a human polluting plot.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x6
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash visit the set of a popular spy movie. When the film's Inteleon star cinematically foils a Team Rocket attack, Goh's Sobble is inspired.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x7
episodes_data.description: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Glimwood Tangle to learn more about Galarian Ponyta and Rapidash. Separated in the forest, they have storybook adventures.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x8
episodes_data.description: After hearing about Wikstrom of the Kalos Elite Four, Ash and Goh travel to his castle to take his test alongside their Farfetch'd and Scyther.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x9
episodes_data.description: While Ash and Goh take advantage of a cold snap to search for Ice Pokémon, Chloe enjoys some girls' time with lab assistant Chrysa at her apartment.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x10
episodes_data.description: When Team Rocket's Pelipper dispenses too many Gulpin from the Prize Master, trouble rolls through Vermilion City. Then, the race is on with Chewtle!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x11
episodes_data.description: Goh finds a Grookey in the lab and tries to capture it, only to learn it belongs to someone else. To locate its owner, he and Ash set out on a search.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x12
episodes_data.description: Ash runs into Rinto, who's also in the World Coronation Series, at the Pokémon Center. He and Farfetch'd challenge Rinto and Gallade to a rematch!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x13
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash offer to help handyperson Multa after her partner is injured. Out on the job, they cross paths with Team Rocket and their latest plot.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x14
episodes_data.description: Goh's Sobble evolves into a Drizzile. But for some reason, it withdraws to a cave in Cerise Park, much to Goh's consternation.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x15
episodes_data.description: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Hoenn to meet race champion trainer Kiley and his Vaporeon. At his suggestion, they enter the Kids Marine Athletic Race.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x16
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash travel to Lavaridge Town to help their old friend Hodge, whose uncle's hot springs have gone dry — perhaps due to an Absol spotted nearby.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x17
episodes_data.description: Ash receives a letter from an old friend in Unova: Iris! He and Goh head to Opelucid City so Ash can face her in a World Coronation Series battle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x18
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash travel to Kalos to find a new flower for one of Goh's Flabébé. After a few days, they visit a plant researcher for some expert insights.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x19
episodes_data.description: Officer Jenny and an Inspector Decker visit the lab, searching for the culprit in a series of electricity thefts. Decker decides Pikachu is responsible!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x20
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh travel to Pallet to visit Professor Oak, who offers Goh a job on the Project Mew research team. They also run into Ash's old frenemy, Gary.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x21
episodes_data.description: Goh and Chloe dispatch their Grookey and Eevee on an errand together but secretly follow them to supervise. Team Rocket do the same with Pelipper.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x22
episodes_data.description: After trying and failing to get rid of their Morpeko, Team Rocket hatch a plan to get Goh to capture it so they don't have to feed it anymore.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x23
episodes_data.description: Goh travels to the Sinnoh region for his first mission with Project Mew, accompanied by Ash. It turns out, becoming a full team member is quite a trial!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x24
episodes_data.description: Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to Driftveil City after hearing about a Klink. Surprised in a cave by Team Rocket, the two groups' members get mixed up!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x25
episodes_data.description: After learning about Falinks from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh go to Galar to see one. Meanwhile, an Eiscue adrift on an ice floe washes up in Galar.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x26
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash head to Sinnoh after reports of nightmares, suspecting the mythical Pokémon Darkrai is responsible. Chloe and Eevee travel to Sinnoh too.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x27
episodes_data.description: Dawn and Chloe find an injured Cresselia and are able to give it first aid. Ash and Goh are still on Darkrai's trail, and so is Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x28
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh race through the mountains on a deserted island in the Alola region — where they meet the lively All-Out brothers, Phil and Mayshure.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x29
episodes_data.description: Ash has leveled up to the Ultra Class! Now, he must face gym leader Volkner in a blazing battle in solar-powered Sunyshore City.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x30
episodes_data.description: Something has caused the Cerise Lab's data to suddenly vanish. Drizzile helps the team track down the mysterious culprit.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x31
episodes_data.description: Adam, Goh and Chloe arrive at Eclipse Castle to meet Espeon and Umbreon and see their special Pokémon powers firsthand.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x32
episodes_data.description: In search of Volcarona, the Sun Pokémon, Ash and Goh head to the Colossus Ruins in the Unova region for Goh's first trial mission from Project Mew.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x33
episodes_data.description: The crew spies the rare and spherical Voltorb and bumps into Gorman, a blue Pokémon fanatic. But Team Rocket plots to ruin the fun with this new friend.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x34
episodes_data.description: The tasty Alcremie, a Pokémon made of cream, floats toward Goh and pals. Later, gym leader Opal arranges a special challenge with Leon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x35
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh run into champion Cynthia while investigating strange phenomena in the Johto region, where daytime has plunged into total darkness.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x36
episodes_data.description: Ash receives a mega glove from cheerleader Korrina in Shalour City. Later, the gang searches for a mega stone to help Lucario mega evolve.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x37
episodes_data.description: Ash and Bea have already faced off twice. Will Ash have better luck during their third showdown at Stow-on-Side Stadium with Korrina in the stands?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x38
episodes_data.description: With a contentious back-and-forth battle with Bea, Ash brings out Sirfetch'd, Pikachu and Lucario to bolster his attacks and defensive strength.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x39
episodes_data.description: Goh brings Ash along to school for a presentation. Later, transfer student Regina and her Glaceon Pokémon cause a freeze over the entire class.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x40
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh dive into the deep waters of the Hoenn region for Goh's trial mission. This time, he's off to catch a wild Kingdra, a Dragon Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x41
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket shows up while Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to the Sinnoh region to investigate multiple missing Pokémon reports — including Dawn's Piplup.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 24 Master Journeys 24x42
episodes_data.description: Time's running out and flowing backwards as Ash, Goh and friends enter a strange world and battle alongside different versions of themselves.
